resources.string: Permission Wizard
Muse UI automation relies on a three-channel permission model. Enable each below; higher levels unlock more operations. UI actions need only Accessibility; shell commands need Shizuku or Root.
Current Permission Level
None (UI automation unavailable)
Accessibility enabled (UI actions available)
Shizuku authorized (UI + shell commands available)
Root authorized (full capabilities available)
Accessibility Service
Accessibility service enabled. UI actions available (click/swipe/input/screenshot/read UI tree).
Not enabled. Authorize \"Muse UI automation\" in system settings.
Open system settings
Shizuku
Muse authorized to use Shizuku
Download Shizuku
Authorize Muse
Shizuku opened. Start the service there, then come back and refresh

Service not running. On Android 11+, enable Developer options, then pair and start via \"Wireless debugging\" inside Shizuku; rooted devices can start directly. After a reboot you must activate it again.
The permission dialog was permanently denied (\"Don\'t ask again\"). Shizuku is open — allow Muse manually inside it
Shizuku permission denied
Timed out waiting for Shizuku authorization, please retry
Shizuku service is not running; start it in the Shizuku app first
Root Permission
Root authorized (fallback channel, can execute su commands directly)
Not rooted or not authorized (used as fallback when Shizuku unavailable)
Suggested next step: %1$s
The basics are ready; the other channels are optional
These permissions stay on this device

Screen reading and command execution happen on this phone; nothing is uploaded. Root, Shizuku and Termux are optional high-privilege channels that let the app act on your device — revoke them any time in system settings or in the matching app.

A root solution was detected, but no manager app (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch) is installed. su requests will be silently denied — install and open the matching manager, then tap \"Request authorization\" above.
This Termux version is too old to return command results. Update to 0.118+ from F-Droid or GitHub (the Play Store version is no longer updated).
Shizuku is too old (v11+ required, v13+ recommended). Please update and retry.
